_comment: Local-studio audio manifest. All prompts and lines are original wording. Run `node tools/gen-audio-local.mjs --dry` to list, `node tools/gen-audio-local.mjs` to generate missing mp3s into public/audio and rewrite public/audio/manifest.json. sfx: Stable Audio Open (prompt, avoid, seconds, seed, optional rms target). music: ACE-Step (prompt tags, bpm, key, seconds, loop). voice: Qwen3-TTS (model, speaker, instruct, text).

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: You have just stepped out into the wasteland with nothing but a jumpsuit and your wits. The ground here glows green in patches, and it will burn anyone who wades through. Grab the supply crate, find the exit, and keep your boots out of the glow.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: An old scrapyard makes a decent firing range. Someone has lined up five tin cans along the fence. Put at least one round into every can, and learn how a shot works before it counts. Take your time, because out here nobody is keeping score yet, and the cans are not shooting back.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Something strange is sprouting in the old allotments, and nobody would call it food. Five swollen plants need cutting down before they spread. Get close, swing hard, and get your hands dirty.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: The giant rats have dug in all around the settlement, and every burrow is packed with hard earth. Put a rifle round through the armour of each mound to drive the vermin out. Watch the damage numbers, because a weak hit gets stopped cold. Patience pays here, so line up each shot like it is your last round.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: A crew of scavengers dug up a stash of power armour in the ruins, and the Brotherhood of Steel wants it back. Three suits stand in a row across the middle of the table. Claim them for your own fighters, or smash them before the other side can climb in.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: In the middle of Big John's salvage yard, between towers of stacked containers, sits a live nuke. Super Mutants guard it, and raiders are itching to steal it. Carry it off the table if you can, but one unlucky shot and the whole yard goes up.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: The old school still holds a few unspoiled books, and out here knowledge is worth more than caps. The defenders have barricaded themselves inside with five of them. The attackers need to break in and haul at least three off the table.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Whoever holds the radio tower controls the airwaves for miles around. The defenders are dug in at its base and expect reinforcements. The attackers are closing in from the edges, and only the end of round six settles who owns it. Dig in, count your friends at the base, and do not trust any of them to stay put.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: A gang has taken Sarah and is holding her in the middle of a ring of ruined buildings. Flip, a Super Mutant she once helped, has come to bring her home. He is badly outnumbered, but he is not leaving without her. Every bullet counts, and so does every step toward the middle of that ring.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Your survivors parked a gigantic scrap rocket in their corner of the truck stop. The Super Mutants camped at the diner are convinced it is a real weapon aimed at them, and they are coming to wreck it. Keep it standing for four rounds, or shove it past the diner and off the table.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: The Super Mutants are dragging a missile across the table on a sled, and nobody wants to learn where it is headed. Stop it before it rolls off the far edge. Just try not to set off the warhead while you do.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: The settlement's water valve sits inside a walled compound, and Super Mutants now patrol it with captive settlers. Slip in quietly, get the water running, and bring half your team back out. Stay unseen and the patrols just keep walking their rounds.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: A tech has escaped the Super Mutants and is hiding somewhere among the scattered wreckage. Both sides are turning over face down markers to find them first. Whoever finds the tech gets to lead them home. The wreckage is thick, the markers all look alike, and the mutants will not wait politely for you to guess.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: A Brotherhood patrol is hunting the Sole Survivor, and the only way out is a locked sewer hatch in the middle of the ground. The keys are stashed in emergency boxes scattered around. Find them, open the hatch, and keep an ear out for something much bigger.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Two prisoners wake up chained together in a raider fighting pit, with junk heaped around their feet. The crowd wants blood, and fresh fighters arrive from round two. Scavenge a weapon, stick with your partner, and outlast every one of them.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: A stack of unstable munitions sits in the corner of your base, and a Super Mutant band is marching straight toward it. Two long walls divide the ground between you. Wipe them out or hold until round eight ends, because if they get there, everything goes up.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Welcome back to the wasteland. Pull up a crate, pick a side, and let the dice decide who walks away.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Round one. The dust settles, and the shooting starts.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Round two. Everyone is a little more tired, and a little more dangerous.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Round three. The easy shots are gone.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Round four. Somebody is running out of luck.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Last round. Whatever you meant to do, do it now.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: Your move.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: That is a win. Take your caps and walk tall.

items.speaker: Ryan
items.instruct: Gravelly, weary, dry baritone narrator with a low pitch and a slow, measured, deadpan pace, like an old wasteland drifter telling a story by a fire.
items.text: That is the end of that. The wasteland keeps what it takes.
